claim.summary: Over any field, let C be a degree-D PC closure, w_1..w_r of degrees e_i<=e, Ann_K(w)={u in V_K: wu in C}, and s=sum_i a_i w_i with deg a_i+e_i<=K', deg s<=sigma, s w_i - w_i in C for every i, K+K'<=D and K+sigma+e<=D. Then intersection_i Ann_K(w_i)=Ann_K(s): the common kernel of the factor maps is one annihilator. Errors E_nu=h_nu w_{i(nu)}+(member) with deg h_nu<=g and K+e+g<=D have that common kernel inside theirs. In a domain model on a finite X with 0/1-valued w_i, s=1-prod(1-w_i) qualifies when K+(r+1)e<=D; for the pigeonhole hole axioms, w_i=x_ij (i in I) and s=sum_{i in I} x_ij qualify when K+2<=D.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in a staged review; the general per-index degrees and the remark that factorization through s=1 is vacuous are its corrections.

claim.summary: Exact F2 computation with tools/pc_closure.py, pigeonhole systems (pigeon axioms prod_j(1+x_ij), hole axioms), multilinear ring, K=1, families of single-variable inputs (g1,g2) with kernel {u in V_1: g1 g2 u in C}: at 4 pigeons, 3 holes, D=3 the six families of check:truncated-kernel-beyond-support have stacked kernel Ann(x_00), dimension 4; at 5 pigeons, 4 holes, D=3 the 15 families (x_00,y), y outside hole 0, have stacked kernel Ann(x_00), dimension 5, against summed codimension 165 in dim V_1=21; the 30 families with first input x_00 or x_10 have stacked kernel of dimension 4, refuting the predicted span{x_20,x_30,x_40} of dimension 3, and equal to Ann(x_00) cap Ann(x_10), which contains 1+x_00+x_10; the 45 families with first input in {x_00,x_10,x_20} have stacked kernel span{1+x_00+x_10+x_20,x_30,x_40}, dimension 3, as predicted before that run.

All instances lie below the pigeon axioms' degree, a domain model on hole-respecting assignments.

claim.summary: The joint saving (sum of ranks minus stacked rank) of error maps in a domain model need not carry into a proper PC quotient containing it: in check:truncated-kernel-beyond-support (F2, 4 pigeons, 3 holes, D=3, K=1, C_3 cap V_1 = 0) the support ranks sum to 66 with stacked rank 12, a saving of 54, while the proper-quotient ranks sum to 20 with stacked rank 9, a saving of 11. B_D inside C_D gives only that each rank and the stacked rank can drop: the stacked proper rank is at most dim U|_S. Corrects the transfer clause of lem:domain-model-stacked-rank.

claim.summary: Over any field F, for a finite set X in F^n, B_D the polynomials of degree <=D vanishing on X, U=V_K/(B_D cap V_K) and errors E_1..E_s of degree <=e with K+e<=D: the map u->[E_j u] in V_D/B_D has rank dim U|_{S_j}, S_j the support of E_j on X, and the stacked map has rank dim U|_S, S the union of the supports; the restriction U|_S -> direct sum of U|_{S_j} is injective, so the sum of ranks exceeds the stacked rank by its cokernel dimension. With X the Boolean cube over F_p this is the domain-only model of cor:pang-observation-calibration at Pang's cutoff Delta+K+d<=D, where every saving over the sum is a union-of-supports interpolation count; such savings carry into Pang's proper quotient since B_D is inside C_D.
claim.assessment: Working proof of the domain-model statement, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer. Its final transfer clause (savings carry into Pang's proper quotient since B_D is inside C_D) is corrected by ex:support-saving-not-inherited: only the inequality stacked proper rank <= dim U|_S follows.

claim.summary: Over F2, let C be the degree-D PC closure of a system containing the Boolean axioms with 1 not in C, g_1,g_2 of degree <=d>=1, P=1+g_1+g_2, E_i=P g_i and 2d+K<=D. Then (a) E_1 = E_2 = g_1 g_2 modulo Boolean consequences of degree <=2d; (b) the kernel {u in V_K: E_i u in C} contains ker_B + (C cap V_K) + A_1 + A_2, with ker_B the support kernel and A_i={u in V_K: g_i u in C}; (c) if g_1 g_2 is in C with degree <=D-K, the kernel is all of V_K, and it strictly contains ker_B + (C cap V_K) exactly when (C cap V_K)|_S differs from V_K|_S for the support S of g_1 g_2 (sufficient in the multilinear ring: dim(C cap V_K) < dim V_K|_S). So proper-quotient error kernels need not be support kernels plus relations.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in two passes; the exact condition in (c) is its follow-up correction.
